tldr: Headlines worldwide lead with the visceral medical detail — a Venezuelan delivery driver detained with a bullet lodged in his back — replicated across six buckets from Canada to India. The sole US right-populist outlet (Breitbart) substitutes protest threats against Trump and ICE as the headline story, while The Atlantic alone surfaces the accountability gap (no body camera on the shooting officer).
